title: ESP32 + DHT11 temperature and humidity sensor
author: Erin Su Öz, Ömer Altan Ünal

parts.name: ESP32-WROOM-32 development board
parts.power: USB cable to a computer or a USB wall adapter

parts.name: DHT11 temperature and humidity sensor, 3-pin module
parts.pin_order: Seen from the front (the side with the blue sensor): S on one end, VCC in the middle, GND on the other end

connections.note: This is the pin next to the S on the front of the Sensor & GPIO 4 is printed as D4 or 4 on the board
Any GND pin works; GND is the module pin at the opposite end from S

notes: The module already has the pull-up resistor the data line needs, so no extra parts are required.
Do not use GPIO 0 for the data line: it is the boot pin and can stop the board from starting or from accepting uploads.
Unplug the USB cable before changing any wiring.
